content.title: Become a Seller
content.intro: Register as a Seller to place your Intellectual Property on Soff Market and earn income! To do this, follow these 5 steps.

step3.title: 3) Fill in the fields, then click the "Register" button after reading the terms.

step4.title: 4) Enter the verification code sent to your number or email in the indicated field, then click the "Submit" button.
step4.note: If the code has not arrived in your email, please check your "Spam" folder.
